# Earthlink Consultants

> UK-based education and visa consultancy. Honest counselling for studies in the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Ireland, Europe, New Zealand, and UAE.

Earthlink Consultants is a UK-registered education and immigration consultancy operating from Harrow since 2017. We file student-visa, work-visa, and university admission applications every week across eight destination countries. Every file is owned end-to-end by a named adviser, and our legal work is signed off by our partners at Stonebridge Solicitors.
